courses.title: International Relations
courses.description: Explores causes and consequences of international political conflict, including war, terrorism, protectionism, nationalism, economic disparity, migration, and humanitarian crises. Analyzes worldviews on war, peace, human rights, and world order.

courses.title: Politics of South Asia
courses.prerequisiteText: Six lower division units in political science or permission of the department.
courses.description: Introduction to the government and politics of South Asia. Focuses on long-term effects of colonialism, state formation, democracy, insurgency, the rise of lower caste and religious parties, the rise of Hindutva and ethnic riots. Connects these phenomena to broader debates in comparative politics on democratization and ethnic conflict.
